task.title: Setting tag expiration from a Dockerfile
task.shortdesc: To expire an image tag automatically in Red Hat Quay, you can add a quay.expires-after label in a Dockerfile. Expiration starts when you push the image to the registry.

context.p: You can add a label, for example, quay.expires-after=20h to an image tag by using the docker label command to cause the tag to automatically expire after the time that is indicated. The following values for hours, days, or weeks are accepted:
Expiration begins from the time that the image is pushed to the registry.
